# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Mary / Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Dick was a big, handsome fellow of the lean kind. He had a feature trait shared by his cousin George Moore and his father, having one blue eye and one hazel eye. He had higher color than his cousin George, and his hair was a shade lighter.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick possessed a little, ugly soul and was always wanting something until he got it, at which point he ceased to care for it. Though mostly pleasant and agreeable when things went well, he drank heavily and was known for bad behavior. His wife Leslie eventually came to hate and despise him.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c21 P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046), [v4 c33 P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)_

## History

Dick Moore grew up in the Glen area as the son of storekeeper Abner Moore. He pursued Leslie West persistently and married her when she was seventeen, but quickly grew restless with quiet married life. In the spring following his marriage, he went to Nova Scotia to visit relatives and joined his double cousin, George Moore, on a voyage to Havana on the vessel 'Four Sisters'. While in Cuba, Dick contracted yellow fever and died thirteen years prior to the events in Montreal. His cousin George stayed behind to nurse him while the vessel sailed, but Dick succumbed to the illness and was buried in Cuba. For twelve years, his cousin George—who suffered a severe head injury shortly after Dick's death and lost his memory—was mistakenly brought home to Four Winds by Captain Jim and believed by everyone, including Leslie, to be Dick Moore.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c21 P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c33 P9](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0009)_
